newsitem.title: USA: Box Energy tests two natural gas wells.
newsitem.headline: Box Energy tests two natural gas wells.

text.p: Box Energy Corp said on Wednesday it completed testing of two natural gas wells in the Gulf of Mexico and Mississippi.
The company said its South Pass Block 89 Well B-7ST was testing at a rate of 2.1 million cubic feet of gas per day from one of the four reservoirs.
This was the first production on South Pass 89 from the Lenticulina sands and was subject to Box Energy's long term gas contract, Box Energy said.
The Walker 10-9 Well tested at a rate of 2.5 million cubic feet per day from one of its six reservoirs, the company said.

The Walker well in Mississippi had been re-entered and successfully completed in the lowest pay sand from 15,270 feet to 15,279 feet, the company said. Box Energy said the well had a total net pay of about 57 feet.

Box Energy also said it had a 33 percent interest in the Gulf of Mexico South Pass well. Its interest would revert to a 25 percent working interest after revenues equal to 300 percent of the well cost, the company said.
